use_case_name: Develop a Natural Language Based Chat Interface (like ChatGPT) to Interact With the Archival Documents
purpose_benefits: NARA plans to develop an AI-powered chat interface, similar to ChatGPT, that will allow users to easily explore its digital archives by asking questions in everyday language. This will make historical documents more accessible and engaging, leading to more efficient research and a deeper understanding of history.
outputs: This AI will create a chat interface that lets users easily get information from NARA's archives by having a conversation with it.
